EmailTemplate.description: Client Liaisons - Check in with client to learn about business changes
EmailTemplate.name: QTP- Insperity Check In
EmailTemplate.subject: Insperity Checking In
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
ATTACH CURRENT INSPERITY SERVICES BROCHURE to Template
Good morning/afternoon,
I hope you are doing well. I am touching base to learn about new developments in your business that may impact your business goals that we had previously identified. As your needs change based on a range of factors, I'm here to explore how Insperity's services can best support you. I want to ensure we are providing the best resources for your specific requirements.
Your strategic partnership with Insperity offers access to a diverse range of teams that can assist you in growing your business.
Diversity Equity and Inclusion - this team assists clients in developing inclusive cultures as a business strategy. Retirement Services - with these services, you can attract top talent by offering savings for retirement and other financial needs for your employees. Performance Management - a web-based performance management system that enables managers and employees to track spending goals, complete performance reviews and manage and track performance notes throughout the year.
This is a small sample of what Insperity offers in our partnership. I've attached a brochure to provider broader information about these fee inclusive resources. Are you free to speak on [insert date and time] to talk more; I can offer specific details about the value of these offerings and how utilizing the full array of Insperity's services has helped many of my clients achieve success.
Thank you for allowing me the opportunity to support your business. [signature]
